# 1.0 ---- Summary of Document ----

To improve processing, may require to modify hex files to remove lines that have
errors. These are typically found when the length is either too short or too 
long compared to the majority. 

Each files from a cruise should be copied and read to identify profiles that 
need manual editing.


Steps:

1. Create cruise folder with a `raw` folder
2. Copy .hex, .hdr, and .xlmcon files into raw
3. Run section 2.2 Load Cruise
  * edit `cruise_id`
  * finds .hex files and creates all folders, copies all `raw` files into `raw_backup`
  * copies .xlmcon files into `derive`
4. Run section 2.3
5. Delete any rows with errors
6. Copy previous psa files into psa
7. Open Sbedataprocessing
8. Run steps in order:
  1: 01DatCnv
  2: 02WildEdit
  3: 03CellTM
  4: 04Filter
  5: 05LoopEdit
  6: 06Derive
  (optional steps)
  7: 07BinAverage
  8: 08Buoyancy
9. Convert .cnv into dataframe by usine `oce` package
10. Remove upcast and inspect

## 2.2 Load Cruise

```{r load-data}
# cruise
cruise_id <- "REACH007"

# hex file path
ctd_raw_path <- 
  here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "raw") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "hex$") %>%
  print()

# xmlcon path
xml_path <- 
  here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "raw") %>% 
  dir_ls(regexp = "(?i)xmlcon$") %>%
  print()

# create folders for each procesing step
dir_create(
  fs::path(
    dirname(ctd_raw_path)[1], "..", 
      c("psa", "datcnv", "filter", "wildedit", "loopedit", "derive", "celltm",
        "binned", "buoyancy")
    )
  )

# create README for when changing files or psa files
file_create(here(dirname(ctd_raw_path)[1], "..", "README.md"))

# copy xmlcon files to 'loopedit' because needed for 'derive' step
file_copy(
  xml_path,
   fs::path(dirname(ctd_raw_path)[1], "..", "loopedit")
)

# create copy of raw files before editing
if (!dir_exists(here(dirname(ctd_raw_path)[1], "..", "raw_backup"))) {
  message("Copying raw files to backup directory.")
  dirname(ctd_raw_path)[1] %>%
    unique() %>%
    dir_copy(here(dirname(.), "raw_backup"))
} else {
  message("Skipping copying of raw files.")
}

```

## 2.3 Check date errors

This looks for rows ending in *0000* that signify corrupt date that sets it to
2000-01-01. After reading all files, this will open files with errors to delete
the bad rows.

```{r}
hex_date_err <-
  # identify date errors
  map(
    .x = ctd_raw_path,
    \(.x) {
      raw_dat <- read_lines(.x)

      # lines for the header
      header <- which(str_detect(raw_dat, "(?i)\\*end\\*"))

      raw_filt <- raw_dat[-c(1:header)]
      raw_count <- str_sub(raw_filt, start = -4)

      # check if ending of row ends in "000" which should signify date error
      bad_row <- which(raw_count == "0000")

      if (length(bad_row) > 0) {
        tibble(
          bad_rows = bad_row + header,
          total_row = length(raw_count)
        )
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "file") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    data         = .,
    id_cols      = file, 
    names_from   = bad_rows,
    values_from  = bad_rows,
    names_sep    = "_",
    names_repair = janitor::make_clean_names
  )
  

hex_date_err

# open files with errors to remove those lines
for (j in unique(hex_date_err$file)) {
  shell(glue("start notepad++ {j}"))
}

```

Identify rows that may be short. This row may include errors, but most likely
not

```{r}
map(
  .x = ctd_raw_path,
  \(.x) {
    raw_dat <- read_lines(.x) 
    
    # lines for the header
    header <- which(str_detect(raw_dat, "(?i)\\*end\\*"))
    
    raw_filt <- raw_dat[-c(1:header)] 
    # raw_count <- str_sub(raw_filt, start = -4)
    
    raw_count <- str_count(raw_filt)
    
    freq_table <- table(raw_count)
    
    most_frequent <- names(freq_table)[which.max(freq_table)] %>%
    as.numeric()
    
    bad_row <- which(raw_count != most_frequent)
    
    if (length(bad_row) > 0) {
      tibble(
        bad_rows = bad_row + header,
        total_row = length(raw_count)) 
    }
  }
) %>%
   bind_rows(.id = "file")
```

## Create batch File for SBEDataProcessing 

```{r}
input_path <-
  here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id) %>%
  normalizePath(, winslash = "\\")

batch_path <- here(input_path, glue("batch_{cruise_id}.txt"))

batch_ctd <-
  glue(
    "@ This batch file can be used to batch process all of the cruise's files with one command.\n",
    "@ Modify the paths below to match the current cruise folder\n",
    "@ How to launch:\n",
    "@ > SBEBatch.exe <path_to_batch_file>\\batch_<cruise id>.txt\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "datcnv /p{input_path}\\psa\\01DatCnv_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\raw\\*.hex /o{input_path}\\datcnv /w\n",
    "wildedit /p{input_path}\\psa\\02WildEdit_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\datcnv\\*.cnv /o{input_path}\\wildedit\n",
    "celltm /p{input_path}\\psa\\03CellTM_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\wildedit\\*.cnv /o{input_path}\\celltm\n",
    "filter /p{input_path}\\psa\\04Filter_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\celltm\\*.cnv /o{input_path}\\filter\n",
    "@ needs psa file -> alignctd /p{input_path}\\psa\\<name>_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\filter\\*.cnv /o{input_path}\\align\n",
    "loopedit /p{input_path}\\psa\\05LoopEdit_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\filter\\*.cnv /o{input_path}\\loopedit\n",
    "derive /p{input_path}\\psa\\06Derive_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\loopedit\\*.cnv  /o{input_path}\\derive /w\n",
    "binavg /p{input_path}\\psa\\07BinAvg_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\derive\\*.cnv  /o{input_path}\\binned\n",
    "buoyancy /p{input_path}\\psa\\08Buoyancy_{str_to_lower(cruise_id)}.psa /i{input_path}\\binned\\*.cnv  /o{input_path}\\buoyancy\n",
  )

batch_ctd

# create batch file
sink(batch_path)
batch_ctd
sink()

# run batch file
if (FALSE) {
  # will pause at steps `datcnv` and `derive` to check input params before continuing
  # remove `/w` if want to skip this
  glue("SBEBatch.exe {batch_path}") %>%
  system()
}
```


# 3.0 Read CTD Files

```{r}
shelf(oce)

cruise_id <- paste0("REACH00", 7)
# cruise_id <- paste0("REACH00", 2:7)

ctd_proc_path <- 
  here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "derive") %>%
  # here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "datcnv_fio") %>%
  # here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "REACH007_CTD_updated") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "cnv$", recurse = TRUE) %>%
  # str_subset("reach007_s23_01", negate = TRUE) %>%
  print() 

ctd_all <-
  map(
    .x = ctd_proc_path,
    \(.x) {
      stn_name <-
        str_remove(.x, "_processed")  %>%
        # str_remove("^.*(?=S|GR|s)") %>%
        str_to_upper(.x) %>%
        str_remove("^.*(?=S|GR|s)") %>%
        str_remove("_.*")  %>%
        str_replace("(C\\d{2})", "/\\1")
      cruise <- str_extract(.x, "REACH\\d{3}")
      message(paste(cruise, ":", stn_name))

      # browser()
      ctd_open <-
        read.ctd(.x, station = stn_name, cruise = cruise) %>%
        oceSetMetadata(name = "cruise", value = cruise) %>%
        subset(flag >= 0) %>%
        ctdTrim()

      return(ctd_open)
    }
  )

# plot profile
# walk(.x = ctd_all, ~ plot(.x))


```

```{r}
map(
  ctd_all,
  \(.x) {
    
    stn <- str_remove(.x@metadata$station, "/")
    # cruise_name <- paste0("FIO_",.x@metadata$cruise)
    cruise_name <- paste0("",.x@metadata$cruise)
    cast_num <- 
      basename(.x@metadata$filename) %>%
      str_extract("(\\d{2})\\.cnv", group = 1)
    
    message(paste0(cruise_name, ": ", stn, " Cast: ", cast_num))
    ctd_data<- as_tibble(.x@data) 
    
    save_dir <- here("data", "plots", glue("{cruise_name}"))
    dir_create(save_dir)
    
    for (nm in names(ctd_data)) {
      ctd_data %>%
      ggplot(aes(y = depth)) +
      scale_y_continuous(transform = "reverse") +
      scale_x_continuous(position = "top") +
      scale_color_manual(values = colorRampPalette(ODV_colours)(23)) +
      # geom_path(aes(x = fluorescence), linewidth = rel(0.5)) +
      geom_path(aes(x = get(nm)), linewidth = rel(0.5)) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(cruise_name, ": ", stn),
         x = nm,
         y = "Depth [m]"
         ) +
      theme_bw()
      
      ggsave(here(save_dir, glue("{nm}_{cruise_name}_{stn}_{cast_num}.png")))
    }
  }
)
```

## 3. Compile All Cast and Save

```{r}
ctd_tib <-
  imap(
    ctd_all,
    \(.x, .y) {
      
      # cruise     <- str_extract(.y, "REACH\\d{3}")
      cruise     <- .x@metadata$cruise
      station    <- .x@metadata$station
      start_time <- .x@metadata$startTime
      cast_num <- 
        basename(.x@metadata$filename) %>%
        str_extract("(\\d{2})\\.cnv", group = 1)
      
      dat <- 
        as_tibble(.x@data) %>%
        mutate(
          .before = 1, 
          cruise = cruise, 
          station = station, 
          cast_num = cast_num,
          time = start_time) %>%
        filter(!is.na(scan))
    }
  ) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  print()


ctd_units <-
  ctd_all %$%
  map(
    .x = .,
    \(.x) {
      .x@metadata$units %>%
        imap(~ tibble(
          param = .y,
          unit  = as.character(.x$unit),
          scale = (.x$scale)
        )) |>
        list_rbind() %>%
        bind_rows(
          data.frame(
            param = c("cruise", "station", "time", "scan", "salinity", "flag"),
            unit = c("string", "string", "yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS", "string", "PSU", ""),
            scale = c("", "", "", "", "", "")
          ),
          .
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          param2 = replace_values(
            param, 
            "theta"         ~ "potential_temp",
            "fluorescence"  ~ "chla_fluorescence",
            "fluorescence2" ~ "cdom_fluorescence"
            ),
          unit = case_when(
            str_detect(param2, "lat|long") ~ "deg",
            str_detect(param2, "temp")     ~ "degC",
            str_detect(param2, "timeJ")    ~ "julian_day",
            str_detect(param2, "theta")    ~ "julian_day",
            .default = unit
          ),
          plot_label = recode_values(
            param2,
            "temperature"       ~ "Temperature (°C)",
            "salinity"          ~ "Salinity",
            "oxygen"            ~ "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)",
            "chla_fluorescence" ~ "Chlorophyll-a (mg/m^3)",
            "cdom_fluorescence" ~ "CDOM (mg/m^3)",
            "turbidity"         ~ "Turbidity (NTU)",
            "density"           ~ "Density (kg/m^3)"
            
          )
        )
    }
  )  %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  print()
```


## 3. Save CTD Cast by Cruise


```{r}
cruise_location <- here("data", "processed", "reach_ctd", "data_processed") 
dir_create(cruise_location)

if (length(unique(ctd_tib$cruise)) > 1) {
  
  ctd_tib %>%
  mutate(cruise_id = cruise) %>%
  nest(.by = cruise_id) %$%
    walk2(
      .x = data,
      .y = cruise_id,
      loc = cruise_location,
      \(.x, .y, loc) {
        write_csv(
          .x,
          here(loc, glue(.y, "_ctd.csv"))
        )
      }
    )
} else {
  write_csv(
    ctd_tib,
    here(cruise_location, glue(cruise_id, "_ctd.csv"))
  )
}
```

```{r}
params <- ctd_units %>%
  filter_out(is.na(plot_label)) %>%
  print()

ctd_img  <- here(cruise_location, "..", "figure")
ctd_img2 <- here(cruise_location, "..", "figure_upper250")
dir_create(ctd_img)
dir_create(ctd_img2)

nest(ctd_tib, .by = cruise)  %$%
  # filter(str_detect(cruise, "REACH003")) %$%
  walk2(
    .x = data,
    .y = cruise,
    save_plt = TRUE,
    # save_plt = FALSE,
    \(.x, .y, save_plt) {
      
      for (i in seq(nrow(params))) {
        column <- params[i, ]
        
        if (!column[[1]] %in% names(.x)) {
          next
        }
        
        # full profiles
        print(ggplot(.x, aes(y = depth, color = station, group = time)) +
          scale_y_continuous(transform = "reverse") +
          scale_x_continuous(position = "top") +
          scale_color_manual(values = colorRampPalette(ODV_colours)(23)) +
          geom_path(aes(x = get(column[[1]][1])), linewidth = rel(0.5)) +
          theme_bw() +
          labs(
            x = column$plot_label,
            y = "Depth [db]",
            color = "Station",
            title = .y
          ))


        print(params$param2[i])
        
        if (save_plt) {
          ggsave(
            here(ctd_img, glue(.y, "_{params$param2[i]}.png")),
            device = "png",
            width  = 8,
            height = 8,
            units  = "in",
            dpi    = 600
            )
          }
        
        # up to 250 m profiles
        print(ggplot(.x, aes(y = depth, color = station, group = time)) +
          scale_y_continuous(transform = "reverse") +
          scale_x_continuous(position = "top") +
          scale_color_manual(values = colorRampPalette(ODV_colours)(23)) +
          geom_path(aes(x = get(column[[1]][1])), linewidth = rel(0.5)) +
          theme_bw() +
          coord_cartesian(ylim = c(250, NA)) +
          labs(
            x = column$plot_label,
            y = "Depth [db]",
            color = "Station",
            title = .y
          ))

        if (save_plt) {
          ggsave(
            here(ctd_img2, glue(.y, "_{params$param2[i]}_upper250.png")),
            device = "png",
            width  = 8,
            height = 8,
            units  = "in",
            dpi    = 600
          )
        }

      }
      
      viewer <- getOption("viewer")
      viewer(ctd_img2)
    }
  )
```

```{r}
# Manually extracted hexidecimal ODV colour palette

sel_stn1 <- c(
  "S08|S07|S06|S05",
  "S01|S02|S03|S04|S05",
  "S08|S09|S10|S11|S12",
  "S15|S16|S17|S18|S19",
  "S23|S22|S21|S20",
  "S15|S14|S13|S12",
  "S20|S19|S12|S05"
) %>%
  paste0("(?i)", .)



for (sel_stn in sel_stn1) {
  sel_stn_num <- which(str_detect(names(ctd_all), sel_stn))

  if (length(sel_stn_num) < 2) {
    message("Not enough stations to plot, skipping.")
    next
  }

  ctd_section <- as.section(ctd_all[str_detect(names(ctd_all), sel_stn)])
  plot(ctd_section)
  plot(
    ctd_section,
    which = "temperature",
    xtype = "track", ztype = "image",
    showBottom = TRUE,
    showStations = TRUE,
    # zcol = oce::oceColorsTemperature
    zcol = rev(ODV_colours)
  )

  plot(
    ctd_section,
    which = "salinity",
    xtype = "track", ztype = "image",
    showBottom = TRUE,
    showStations = TRUE,
    # zcol = oce::oceColorsTemperature
    zcol = rev(ODV_colours)
  )
}
```

```{r}
    # lemon::geom_pointline(aes(x = temperature), linewidth = rel(1), size = rel(0.1)) +
    # geom_path(aes(x = get(column[[1]][1])), size = rel(0.5)) +
    geom_path(aes(x = get(column[[1]][1])), linewidth = rel(0.5)) +
    geom_path(
      # data = as.data.frame(oce::subset(ctd_test, flag >= 0)@data),
      data = as.data.frame(ctd_test@data),
      aes(x = get(column[[1]][1]), y = pressure), color = "green", alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = column[[1]][2],
      y = "Depth [db]",
      color = "Station"
    )
  )
}
```

# Read xmlcon File

```{r read-xmlcon}
shelf(xml2)

ctd_xml_path <- 
  # here("../reach_ctd_data", cruise_id, "raw") %>%
  # here("../reach_ctd_data", "REACH007", "raw") %>%
  here("../reach_ctd_data", "REACH007", "raw_backup") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "(?i)xml") %>%
  print() 


# see all sensor names to use in xml_find_first
ctd_sensors <- 
  ctd_xml_path %>%
  map(
    \(.x) {
      ctd_xml <- read_xml(.x)
      
      # temp, conductivity, pressure
      tcp <-
        xml_find_all(ctd_xml, ".//TCP_Sensors") %>% 
        xml_children() %>%
        xml_children() %>%
        xml_name()
        
      # all other sensors
      other <-
        xml_find_all(ctd_xml, ".//ExternalVoltageSensors ") %>% 
        xml_children() %>%
        xml_children() %>%
        xml_name()
      
      list("tcp" = tcp, "other" = other)
    }
  )

ctd_sensors %>%
  list_flatten() %>%
  list_c() %>%
  tibble(sensors = .) %>%
  count(sensors)
  

ctd_xml <-
  ctd_xml_path %>%
  map(
    .x = .,
    \(.x) {
      ctd_xml <- 
        read_xml(.x) %>%
        # search for fluorescence calibration
        xml_find_first(".//FluoroWetlabECO_AFL_FL_Sensor") %>%
        xml_children()

      tibble(
        field = xml_name(ctd_xml),
        value = xml_text(ctd_xml)
      ) %>%
        pivot_wider(
          data         = .,
          names_from   = c(field),
          values_from  = c(value),
          names_sep    = "_",
          names_repair = janitor::make_clean_names
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          
          file_full = .x, 
          file = basename(.x), 
          .before = 1
          )
    }
  ) %>%
  list_rbind() 

ctd_xml

# filter for specific scaling factor
ctd_xml %>%
  mutate(
    scale_factor = as.numeric(scale_factor)
  ) %>%
  filter(scale_factor == 6) %>%
  pull(file) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n*") 


write_csv(ctd_xml, here("data", "metadata", "REACH007_instrument_cal.csv"))

```



```{r}
# reacho007 second update
ctd_cnv_path <- 
  here("../reach_ctd_data", "REACH007", "REACH007_CTD_updated") %>%
  dir_ls(regexp = "(?i)cnv", recurse = TRUE) %>%
  print()

map(
  ctd_cnv_path,
  # search = "FluoroWetlabECO_AFL_FL_Sensor",
  search = "TurbidityMeter",
  \(.x, search) {
    message(basename(.x))
    ctd_lines <- readLines(.x)


    header <-
      ctd_lines[seq_len(which(trimws(ctd_lines) == "*END*") - 1L)] %>%
      str_remove("^(\\s?#|\\*)\\s?")


    start <- grep(paste0(search, "\\b"), header)
    end <- grep(paste0("</", search, ">"), header)

    fields <-
      paste(header[start:end], collapse = "\n") %>%
      read_xml() %>%
      xml_children()

    # sensor_info <-
    tibble(
      field = xml_name(fields),
      value = xml_text(fields)
    ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        data         = .,
        names_from   = c(field),
        values_from  = c(value),
        names_sep    = "_",
        names_repair = janitor::make_clean_names
      ) %>%
    mutate(
      .before = 1,
      file = paste("*", basename(.x))
    )
  }
) %>%
  list_rbind()
```
